Name: Gifts from Caroline
Author: LoganDoidao989
Description:
Receive a gift by mail at every level of friendship with Caroline. 

Finally a good reason to make new friends 

Gifts range from seeds to machines, it will depend on your new friend and how much you are friends 

Each NPC has a unique selection of gifts that will give you!

Caroline will give you things she likes and useful items 

Look at the spoiler below for more details.
